replies.author: BenTheSodaman
replies.body:
To reframe one of angrylittledev's perspectives, most generative AI sites / tools that you aren't running locally are going to be a paywall if you want to use it beyond the trials. 

e.g., Grok Imagine, Tripo, Meshy, Rodin, Hunyuan 3.1, VEO, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Seeddance 2.0, Kling 3.0, Suno ai, Claude, Codex, etc.

And before someone says, "Well no shit. It's not a charity," the context of their post implied there were workflows that were free indefinitely.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body:
No Posts Promoting Commercial Services or Products

Direct or indirect promotion of commercial services or products is not allowed.

Discussion about services and products is fine, up to a point. Overt and repeated promotion is not, even if its only in comments.

No promotion of commercial services or products - Commercial GAMES are OK, but direct or indirect promotion of commercial services or products is not allowed. Discussion about them is fine, but overt and repeated promotion is not.
